scope: Five-family creature/form/temporary-HP slice: all original broad candidates in Druid/Mage/Mirrorsage/Ranger/Wizard, plus semantic companion supplements. Incidental guards and deferred forms/tempHP must be classified separately. Not a completeness claim.

classRecords.text: Shifting: Bonus Action, one long-rest shift use, 10 minutes, early reversion Bonus Action. Reaching 0 HP or incapacitation ends form; excess damage stays on your own HP. Shift uses follow detailed book table:2 at 1, 3 at 4, 4 at 7, 5 at 10, 6 at 13, 7 at 16, 8 at 19. Supplemental runtime alternative 2/3/4/5/6 at 1/4/8/12/16 remains preserved. At 20 changing form is unlimited but does not refill finite form benefits. Speech unavailable in Base forms, available in Arch/Hero. No spellcasting in form until Beast Spells 18 except an explicit form permission. Maintaining an existing spell concentration is allowed, still only one concentration. Changing form spends a use and ends old form features/summons; it does not reset once/rest abilities.

Transformation reserves prevent unlimited replacement HP: at long rest record Buffer Reserve=2 L+M and Form Surge Reserve=PB. A form giving temporary HP draws that many from Buffer Reserve, up to remaining amount, with normal nonstacking; never real healing. A form special described once/transformation also spends 1 Form Surge and cannot be refreshed by resuming the form. Form Surge refills only long rest. Forms cannot grant free casts, RP or shift uses. Auras affect at most 3 enemies and once per enemy per round; retaliation once/round total; ongoing riders refresh, never stack. Entering a legal Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce accumulated Dissonance. Natural attacks do not clear Refrain.

card.name: Shapeshifting
card.effect: Assume an unlocked prepared form or revert early. Apply engine HP, equipment, concentration and reserve rules. This is not a spell and cannot copy monster stat blocks.

source.originalText:
Shapeshifting
At 1st level, you gain the ability to transform into various animal forms. Shapeshifting is Aethel's native druidic transformation discipline and functions according to the following rules:

Activation and Duration
You can use a bonus action to assume a beast form. You can remain in beast form for 10 minutes per use. You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn.

Uses per Day
At 1st level, you can use your Shapeshifting ability twice per long rest. You gain additional uses as you reach higher levels, as shown in the Shapeshifting Uses column of the Druid table.

Available Forms
At 1st level, you can transform into any of the Base Druid Forms listed below. At 11th level, you gain access to Arch Druid Forms. At 10th level, you gain access to Hero Druid Forms specific to your chosen Circle.
Limitations While Transformed
While in beast form:
You cannot cast spells unless specified by your Hero Class
Your ability to speak is limited (only preserved in arch/hero forms)
You retain your mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma)
You gain the physical traits of the chosen form as specified

card.name: Bear Form (Tank)
card.cost: One shift; buffer drawn from reserve
card.effect: Gain up to 20 temporary HP from reserve; AC max(normal, 14). Claw 2d6 slashing+WIS+1. Buffer disappears on reversion and cannot be refilled through free shifting.

source.originalText:
Bear Form (Tank)
+20 HP temporary buffer
AC set to 14 (unless your normal AC is higher)
Claw: 2d6 slashing damage
Rage-like trait: Deal +1 damage per attack

card.name: Archdruid
card.effect: Unlimited legal form changes. Buffer Reserve and Form Surges remain finite; per-rest powers, spell costs and uses never refresh on changing form. Ignore verbal/somatic and noncostly unconsumed material components for Druid spells, including in form.

source.originalText:
Archdruid
At 20th level, you can use your Shapeshifting feature an unlimited number of times.
Additionally, you can ignore the verbal and somatic components of your druid spells, as well as any material components that lack a cost and aren't consumed by a spell. You gain this benefit in both your normal shape and your beast shapes from Shapeshifting.

card.name: Dire Wolf
card.duration: Form 10 minutes; fear up to 3 rounds
card.effect: Arch attunement required. Speed 40 ft, bite 2d6 piercing+WIS; advantage when active ally threatens target 5 ft. Howl Action up to 3 enemies WIS save or Frightened, repeat end each turn, maximum 3 rounds. No free bite with Howl.

source.originalText:
Dire Wolf
Pack Tactics: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and not incapacitated
Bite: 2d6 piercing damage
Howl: As an action, you can emit a frightening howl. Each hostile creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

card.name: Earth Warden (Dire Bear)
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures
card.effect: Arch attunement required. Gain up to 30 temp HP from reserve, nonmagical physical resistance. Slam DEX save 2d6 bludgeoning+WIS and Prone on failure, half damage no Prone success. Ordinary claw 1d8+WIS when Slam unavailable.

source.originalText:
Earth Warden (Dire Bear)
30 temporary hit points while in this form
Earth Slam: As an action, you can slam the ground, causing a shockwave in a 10-ft. radius. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.
Stone Resistance: You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

card.name: Sky Serpent
card.effect: Arch attunement required. Flight 80 ft with hover, +2 DEX saves. Bite 2d8 lightning+WIS. Once/shift may spend 1 Form Surge to add 1d4 against wet target; no repeated electrical propagation.

source.originalText:
Sky Serpent
Flight speed of 80 ft.
Lightning Bite: Your bite deals 2d8 lightning damage
Glide Reflexes: You gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws

card.name: Shadow Lynx
card.effect: Arch attunement required. Claw 2d4+WIS magical slashing; +2 Stealth while motionless. When attack would hit, Reaction teleport 30 ft to visible empty space, causing triggering attack to miss if you leave its reach/range. Next claw before end next turn advantage. No blanket immunity to magical damage.

source.originalText:
Shadow Lynx
Blink: As a reaction when you would be hit by an attack, you can teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see
Magical Attacks: Your attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks
Druid Circles
Circle of the Land

card.name: Combat Shapeshifting
card.effect: Restore 1d8 real HP per RP paid, never beyond maximum. Does not restore temporary buffer or shift uses. No Dissonance as class technique; cannot heal after form ended/incapacitated.

source.originalText:
Combat Shapeshifting
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain Combat Shapeshifting. While transformed by Shapeshifting, you can use a bonus action to expend one or more Resonance Points, regaining 1d8 hit points for each RP expended. Activating Shapeshifting itself still spends a Shapeshifting use, not RP.

card.name: Beastlord (Alpha Animal Hybrid)
card.effect: Bite 2d6+WIS piercing; first hit/turn adds 1d4 of one chosen fire/cold/lightning, not all three. Up to 2 beast allies 30 ft gain+1 first attack/turn. Howl Action up to 3 enemies WIS save or Frightened until end next turn.

source.originalText:
Beastlord (Alpha Animal Hybrid)
Chimera Cub: Your attacks deal 1d4 each of fire, cold, and lightning damage in addition to their normal damage
Alpha Dire Wolf: You can intimidate all creatures within 15 ft. As an action, each creature in range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute
Pack Leader: Beast allies within 30 ft. of you gain advantage on attack rolls

card.name: Mooncursed
card.effect: Resistance to nonmagical physical damage except silver; other types unchanged. Bite 2d6+WIS piercing, +1d8 once/turn under real full moon. Howl Action choose up to 3 allies gain 2d8 temp HP total roll, or 3 enemies WIS save or Frightened through end next turn. Temp HP draws from Buffer Reserve per recipient.

source.originalText:
Mooncursed
Lycanthropic Resilience: You have resistance to all damage except silver
Lunar Rage: During a full moon, your attacks deal an additional 1d8 damage
Howl of the Wild: As an action, you can emit a howl that inspires allies or terrifies enemies. Choose one effect: allies within 30 ft. gain 2d8 temporary hit points, or enemies within 30 ft. must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

card.name: Elemental Shapeshifting
card.cost: One shift and one elemental use
card.effect: Choose bounded elemental form: AC 16, natural attack 2d8+WIS chosen element, one/Action. Air flight 60 lightning resistance; Earth burrow 20 through loose soil physical DR 2; Fire fire resistance and melee attacker 1d4 fire once/round; Water swim 60 water breathing cold resistance. Retain own HP/abilities, no external stat blocks.

source.originalText:
Elemental Shapeshifting
At 14th level, you gain the ability to transform into an elemental. You can transform into an air elemental, an earth elemental, a fire elemental, or a water elemental. You can use this feature twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

card.name: Tempest Raptor
card.effect: Flight 60 ft, advantage on saves against wind/lightning while airborne. Claw 2d6+WIS lightning; wet target adds 1d4 once/shift for 1 Form Surge. After melee hit on you, attacker takes 1d6 lightning once/round; no repeated disarm chains.

source.originalText:
Tempest Raptor
Lightning Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d6 lightning damage
Flight: You have a flying speed of 60 ft.
Storm Shroud: You are surrounded by crackling electricity. Creatures that touch you or hit you with a melee attack take 1d6 lightning damage.

card.name: Thunderhorn Stag
card.rangeAndTarget: Storm Hero; antlers 5 ft; teleport 30 ft
card.effect: Antlers 1d8+WIS piercing; after 20 ft approach first hit/turn also 2d8 thunder and CON save or Deafened through end next turn. Step Action teleport 30 ft, departure 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures CON save 2d8 thunder, half success. Sense natural storm approach 24 hours, no exact prediction of magical weather.

source.originalText:
Thunderhorn Stag
Charge: If you move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit with a horn attack, the target takes 2d8 thunder damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of its next turn
Thunder Step: Once per transformation, you can teleport up to 30 ft. in a crack of thunder. Each creature within 10 ft. of the space you left must make a Constitution saving throw or take 2d8 thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn.
Weather Sense: You can sense approaching storms up to 24 hours in advance

card.name: Frost Wyrmling
card.cost: One shift; breath one short-rest use
card.rangeAndTarget: Winterfang Hero; 30 ft cone up to 3 creatures
card.effect: AC normal+2, cold immunity. Claw 1d8+WIS cold. Breath 4d6 cold DEX half. One breath target may have cold resistance ignored once/shift for 1 Form Surge; immunity remains. No general physical resistance from cold terrain in this draft.

source.originalText:
Frost Wyrmling
Breath Weapon: As an action, you can exhale a 30-foot cone of freezing air. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 4d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Once you use this breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.
Scales of Ice: You gain a +2 bonus to AC
Cold Immunity: You are immune to cold damage

card.name: Swarm Summoning
card.effect: Summon one swarm using shared companion profile: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP 2 L, Speed 30, melee attack PB+WIS for S d6 piercing. Bonus Action command, one damaging action across all pets. Tiny-body movement through 1 inchgaps; no separate attacks per insect.

source.originalText:
Swarm Summoning
Starting at 2nd level, you can summon a swarm of tiny creatures to aid you. As an action, you can summon a swarm of insects, rats, or spiders (your choice) in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. The swarm acts on your initiative count and obeys your verbal commands. It lasts for 10 minutes, until it drops to 0 hit points, or until you dismiss it as a bonus action.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

card.name: Carrion Rat King
card.effect: Bite 1d8+WIS piercing+2d6 poison; CON save or Poisoned through end next turn. Immune disease/Poisoned, not poison damage. Summon Action creates one bounded engine swarm 1 minute, same command budget; replaces previous form swarm.

source.originalText:
Carrion Rat King
Poison Bite: Your bite attack deals 1d8 piercing damage plus 2d6 poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.
Summon Swarm: As an action, you can summon a swarm of rats that acts on your initiative and obeys your mental commands. The swarm lasts for 1 minute or until reduced to 0 hit points.
Disease Immunity: You are immune to disease and the poisoned condition.

card.name: Insect Broodmother
card.rangeAndTarget: Rotshaper Hero; up to 2 swarms adjacent
card.effect: AC normal+3, climb 30 walls/ceilings, bite 1d8+WIS piercing. On entry optional spend surge spawn 2 bounded shared profile swarms, both end with form, combined one commanded attack/turn. Once/shift for another Form Surge turn one crit against you into normal hit; no infinite insects.

source.originalText:
Insect Broodmother
Spawn Swarms: Each time you transform into this form, you can spawn 1d4 swarms of insects (CR 1/4 each) that act on your initiative and obey your mental commands. The swarms last until they are reduced to 0 hit points or until you revert to your normal form.
Chitinous Armor: You gain a +3 bonus to AC
Wall Crawling: You can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without making an ability check.

card.name: Master of Vermin
card.effect: Swarm form: own HP/AC, physical resistance, Speed 30, fit Tinygaps, natural attack S d6+WIS piercing. No flight unless choosing bats (flight 30), which forfeits physical resistance. Replacing a summoning spell's beast with swarm uses same single companion budget and paid spell, never multiplied dice/creatures.

source.originalText:
Master of Vermin
At 14th level, you gain the ability to transform into a swarm of tiny beasts (insects, rats, bats, or spiders) as if using your Shapeshifting feature. While in swarm form, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and you can move through any space large enough for a Tiny creature without squeezing.
Additionally, when you cast a spell that summons or creates beasts, you can choose to summon a swarm instead of individual creatures.

card.name: Blazing Rebirth
card.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Grove; ally/self 30 ft taking fire damage
card.effect: Grant L+M temporary HP after real hostile/environmental fire damage. Cannot reduce triggering hit retroactively or trigger from deliberate ally/self-farming. Normal temporary HP nonstacking; no buffer reserve payment because finite feature use.

source.originalText:
Blazing Rebirth
Starting at 2nd level, you can channel the regenerative power of fire. When you or an ally within 30 feet of you takes fire damage, you can use your reaction to grant temporary hit points equal to your druid level + your Wisdom modifier to that creature.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

card.name: Charbear
card.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Hero; claw 5 ft/aura 5 ft/smoke 10 ft
card.effect: Claw 2d8+WIS fire; first hit/turn Burn 1d4 next turn. Up to 3 enemies starting 5 ft CON save or 1d6 fire. Smoke Action opaque 10 ft radius sphere centered fixed point you occupy, concentration 3 rounds; all vision blocked, no poison in this draft. Wind 20 mph disperses.

source.originalText:
Charbear
Flame Aura: Creatures within 5 ft. of you take 1d6 fire damage at the start of their turn
Fire Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d8 fire damage
Smoke Cloud: As an action, you can create a 20-foot-radius sphere of smoke centered on yourself. The area is heavily obscured, and creatures other than you that start their turn in the smoke must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of their next turn.

classRecords.text: All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot grant additional Actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions. Mage summons and companions do not receive independent damaging turns: all Mage-controlled conjured companions share one Companion Command per Mage regular turn. Spend one Bonus Action to command exactly one companion to move up to its Speed and use one damaging or control action from its stat block. Uncommanded companions may move to remain near you and take Dodge but cannot deal damage or impose control.

LICH COMPANION SYSTEM. A successful Lich transformation unlocks three unique bound elite companions: Boneflayer, Dreadblade and Wraithbound. You can maintain at most one of each, maximum three total. They return at full HP after a completed long rest unless a campaign consequence expressly prevents it. A destroyed elite leaves no usable corpse and cannot generate XP, loot, RP, Nuke Chain credit, Soul Reservoir or kill-based resources. Soulbound Ritual can return one before a long rest.

LICH RITUAL CHECK. After all readiness gates and the divine-echo encounter are completed, roll d20 + Intelligence modifier + Constitution modifier against DC 20, applying the third-guardian +2 and willing-participant advantage where applicable. Success completes the Lich transformation and unlocks its cards and elite companions. Failure after explicit consent applies the historical failure state and the Director pauses for the agreed player-to-NPC handoff before continuing play. No silent PC deletion is permitted.

card.name: Resonance Shield
card.cost: Spend X RP, where X is 1, 2 or 3
card.duration: 1 minute or until temporary HP are lost
card.effect: Resonance Shield. Tags: mage-spell, abjuration, protection. Spend 1-3 RP and gain temporary HP equal to X × (S + M). Temporary HP do not stack. This spell is non-elemental and therefore clears an active Elemental Nuke Chain. Its RP payment cannot be reduced below 1 by Spell Efficiency.

source.originalText: Resonance Shield: Convert a portion of your Resonance Points into a temporary protective barrier.

card.name: Conjure Elemental Familiar
card.effect: Conjure Elemental Familiar. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, summon, elemental. Summon one elemental familiar matching your current Focus using the common familiar stat block. Only one elemental familiar from this feature may exist at once; summoning another dismisses the first. It obeys the shared Companion Command rule. It disappears at 0 HP or when duration ends and leaves no corpse, XP, loot or resource trigger.

source.originalText: Conjure Elemental Familiar: Summon a minor elemental of your chosen type to assist you in combat.

card.name: Empowered Link
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to M allies within 25 feet
card.duration: Matches the shared benefit, maximum until end of your next regular turn
card.effect: Empowered Link. Tags: archmage, buff. When one of your Mage cards grants you temporary HP, a Speed bonus or a numeric attack/save bonus, choose up to M allies within 25 feet. They gain the same non-resource benefit at half its numeric amount rounded down, minimum 1 where applicable. It never shares Actions, RP, Focus, concentration, invisibility, summons or class resources. Resistance is not a numeric bonus and is not shared by this card.

source.originalText: Empowered Link: Share buffs with allies in a 5-tile radius.

card.name: Harmonized Core
card.duration: Temporary HP until lost or replaced
card.effect: Harmonized Core. Tags: archmage, support. After one of your damaging Mage spells deals damage, choose one ally within 30 feet. It gains temporary HP equal to 10% of one target's unmodified rolled damage dice total from that spell, rounded down, minimum 1 and maximum S+M. This is not HP healing and cannot trigger healing features or Echo-style repetitions.

source.originalText: Harmonized Core: Spells heal allies for 10% of base damage as temporary HP.

card.name: Arcane Sanctuary
card.effect: Arcane Sanctuary. Tags: mage-spell, archmage, zone, concentration. On start and each paid Bonus Action maintenance pulse, allies in the zone gain S+M temporary HP until the start of your next regular turn or effect end, whichever is first and +1 to Mage or spell attack rolls while inside. The zone grants no save-DC increase and no additional Actions. Maximum 3 pulses.

source.originalText: Arcane Sanctuary: Create a zone of protection that shields allies and enhances their magical abilities.

card.name: Spell Sharing
card.cost: 4 RP plus the shared card's printed RP cost
card.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
card.effect: Spell Sharing. Tags: archmage, spell-sharing. Choose one Base or Arch Mage spell card you know with an Action activation and printed base RP cost 4 or less. Pay both costs now. The ally may cast that card once before the end of its next turn without paying RP, using your Mage spell attack and DC. It cannot share summons, Counterspell, Hero cards, finishers, Resonance Surge or another Spell Sharing.

source.originalText: Spell Sharing: Temporarily grant an ally access to one of your spells.

card.name: Elemental Supremacy
card.frequency: Always; reset at most once per round
card.effect: Elemental Supremacy. Tags: elementalist, focus, vulnerability. Once on each of your turns when a Mage spell deals a damage type to which its target is vulnerable, add S damage of that type after vulnerability is applied. Additionally, when a hostile non-summoned creature that meaningfully threatened the party dies from one of your Focus-eligible spells, you may reset your current Focus finisher's positive recharge counter to 0, subject to the universal reset limit.

source.originalText: Elemental Supremacy: Deal +10% damage against elemental vulnerabilities; reset chain cooldown on kill.

card.name: Primal Channeling
card.effect: Primal Channeling. Tags: elementalist, resonance. During a real encounter, draw ambient elemental energy and restore 2 RP, never above your maximum. You cannot use Primal Channeling outside a real encounter, during a rest, through a summoned proxy or more than once per short rest. It does not count as a spell cast, does not advance Nuke Chain and does not alter Dissonance.

source.originalText: Primal Channeling: Draw raw elemental energy from the environment to empower your spells.

card.name: Soul Reservoir
card.frequency: At most once per turn and at most S times per encounter
card.effect: Soul Reservoir. Tags: lich, resonance, damage-over-time. During a real encounter, when a hostile creature takes damage from a damage-over-time effect created by one of your Mage spells, restore 1 RP, never above maximum. The same damage event cannot restore more than 1 RP. Damage to allies, summons, trivial creatures or your own companions does not qualify.

source.originalText: Soul Reservoir: All DoT damage you deal feeds Resonance recovery.

card.name: Necromantic Mastery
card.effect: Necromantic Mastery. Tags: lich, necromancy. Once on each of your turns when a Mage spell deals necrotic damage, add S necrotic damage to one damaged target. Your necrotic Mage spells also ignore resistance to necrotic damage; immunity remains immunity. This feature does not convert another spell's damage type and cannot apply to companion attacks unless a card explicitly identifies them as your spell.

source.originalText: Necromantic Mastery: Gain access to enhanced necromancy spells and abilities.

card.name: Lingering Malice
card.effect: Lingering Malice. Tags: mage-spell, lich, necrotic, zone, concentration. Choose Fear or Drain when cast. On start and each paid Bonus Action maintenance pulse, enemies in the zone make Wisdom saves. Failure takes S d6 necrotic. Fear mode also Frightens until the start of your next turn. Drain mode lets you gain temporary HP equal to M once per pulse if at least one enemy fails. Maximum 3 pulses; each pulse grants a new save.

source.originalText: Lingering Malice: Create a necrotic zone for 3 rounds that applies Fear or Drain effects.

card.name: Resonance to Flesh
card.effect: Resonance to Flesh. Tags: lich, resonance, blood. Choose one direction. RP to Flesh: spend 1-5 RP and regain 2 HP per RP spent. Flesh to RP: lose 2-10 HP in even increments and restore 1 RP per 2 HP lost. HP loss cannot be reduced, redirected or transferred and cannot reduce you below 1 HP. RP cannot exceed maximum. This feature cannot be repeated through Echoes or companions.

source.originalText: Resonance to Flesh: Convert Resonance into HP (or vice versa) once per rest.

card.name: Corpse Gateway
card.rangeAndTarget: One visible corpse within 60 feet and one unoccupied space within 5 feet of it
card.effect: Corpse Gateway. Tags: mage-spell, lich, teleportation, corpse. Teleport to the chosen unoccupied space adjacent to a visible corpse. The corpse is not consumed or altered. Summoned-companion remains, repeated fragments of the same destroyed creature and illusory corpses are not legal anchors. This non-elemental spell clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Corpse Gateway: Teleport to a corpse within line of sight.

card.name: Soulbound Ritual
card.rangeAndTarget: One of your destroyed bound elite undead companions within 30 feet or its inert binding token
card.effect: Soulbound Ritual. Tags: mage-spell, lich, companion, resurrection. Return one destroyed Boneflayer, Dreadblade or Wraithbound to an unoccupied space within 30 feet at half its maximum HP. It gains S+M temporary HP for 1 minute. The returned companion remains subject to the shared Companion Command limit and cannot create a corpse, XP, loot or resource event if destroyed again.

source.originalText: Soulbound Ritual: Revive a fallen undead pet with bonus stats.

classRecords.text: Mirrorbind is an Action, once per encounter, against a creature within 60 ft whose eligible ability you saw resolve since the start of your previous turn. Target must have INT 6 or lower, not be a boss or possess unique/legendary status unless an encounter script explicitly permits copying. It makes WIS save versus class DC; failure captures one witnessed ability into an empty slot. No copying from allies, your companions, another copy, a corpse, a recharge-limited legendary power or an at-will source that itself restores resources. You can voluntarily erase a slot without an action on your turn, permanently losing its record.

Record source creature/name, witnessed ability, category, damage type, allowed rank, capture encounter and whether first release has occurred. For this pilot, capture copies the observed role into ONE bounded profile: Strike=one target 60 ft class spell attack S d8 observed damage type; Burst=up to 3 enemies in 10 ft radius within 30 ft DEX save S d6, half on success; Mend=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Ward=one ally 30 ft S d6+M temporary HP for 1 minute; Hindrance=one enemy 30 ft WIS save or Speed-10 ft and no Reactions until end its next turn. Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

One Mirror Beast OR Reflective Companion, never both. Mirror Beast uses standard companion stats, initially copies appearance only, and costs a Bonus Action to command. You may command it to make its normal attack OR originate your round's Echo Release from its position, paying RP and consuming the record normally; not both. You still supply an Action for release unless a feature specifically changes that action cost. A shifted appearance grants no extra actions/stats. Destroying/dismissing it grants no capture, corpse, XP or recovery. Charm Bind is 1/long rest, 3 rounds, concentration, INT 6-or-lower target WIS save and repeat at each turn end/when harmed by your side; never a player character or boss without explicit encounter permission. A charmed companion uses its own ordinary attack with damage capped at standard companion S d6; unique spells/powers remain unavailable.

Standard acquisition applies; baseline Mirrorbind, Echo Release and summon procedure become usable by selecting their cards. Echo Channeling and Mirrorcall are upgrades, not duplicate mandatory unlocks. The contradiction between source initial 3 slots and Expansion I 2→3 is reconciled as an archive-safety upgrade below. Perfect Reflection automatic 9, Hero choice 10, corresponding Final 20. The finale does not override copy eligibility or the shared release cap.

card.name: Mirrorcall
card.effect: Beast gains+M maximum/current HP when summoned and+5 ft Speed. Echo Release or Mirror Beast Summon already provides its base procedure; this is an optional enhancement, not a second required unlock.

source.originalText: Mirrorcall: Summon a Mirror Beast that mimics one stored Echo ability.

card.name: Mirror Beast Summon
card.effect: Summon one standard Mirror Beast; replaces any prior Beast/Reflective Companion. Choose appearance of a stored source. It attacks only on Bonus Action command or originates your paid release with Action+command, never both. No copied anatomy, regeneration or immortality.

source.originalText: Mirror Beast Summon: Call forth a Mirror Beast that can use one of your stored Echo abilities.

card.name: Charm Creature
card.rangeAndTarget: One eligible INT 6-or-lower creature within 30 ft
card.effect: WIS save or become Reflective Companion under engine restrictions. It repeats save at turn end and when harmed by your side. Replaces Mirror Beast; on end original disposition returns. Requires no suicidal orders; cannot force beliefs or permanently enslave.

source.originalText: Charm Creature: Attempt to temporarily charm a low-intelligence creature to fight alongside you.

card.name: Advanced Mirrorcall
card.effect: You may change Beast appearance to another stored source as a Bonus Action without resummoning or restoring HP. It gains either+10 ft swim or climb Speed until it ends. No new release, attack or capture.

source.originalText: Advanced Mirrorcall: Mirror Beast can now shift once per fight into a new form based on a second Echo.

card.name: Mirror Shift
card.effect: Switch its appearance to a stored source and choose swim 30 ft or climb 30 ft until next shift. Restore no HP or attacks; no flight, incorporeality or copied creature special actions. Does not release or consume the Echo.

source.originalText: Mirror Shift: Command your Mirror Beast to change form, adopting a different stored Echo ability.

card.name: Luminant Bond
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies/enemies within 10 ft of your Beast/Companion
card.effect: Allies gain+1 to WIS saves. Invisible enemies in aura shed faint outlines and cannot gain advantage solely from invisibility, but concealment/cover still apply. This grants neither full True Sight nor targeting through walls.

source.originalText: Luminant Bond: Charmed/Beast emits aura that reveals invisible and grants +5% saves.

card.name: Radiant Archive
card.cost: RP for 3 support Echoes; consume all 3; 1 long-rest use
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 legal allies within 30 ft
card.effect: Release three stored Mend/Ward records as ONE package; assign each to one ally. No ally receives more than two components and temporary HP never stack. All costs paid; no extra release or resurrection. Missing records cannot be invented.

source.originalText: Final – Radiant Archive: Cast 3 stored divine Echoes at once (once/day).

card.name: Radiant Mirror Beast
card.effect: Summon radiant standard Beast. Bonus Action command chooses normal attack or healing S d4 to one living ally within 5 ft, paying 1 RP per heal. It may instead originate your paid Echo release under common limits. Cannot perform two options in one round.

source.originalText: Radiant Mirror Beast: Summon a Mirror Beast infused with divine energy, capable of healing allies and revealing hidden threats.

card.name: Blessing Echo
card.cost: Recorded RP cost+1; consume offensive Echo
card.effect: Convert a stored Strike/Burst record to Mend/Ward for this release, chosen on activation; heal S d6+M or grant same temporary HP. This explicit conversion cannot also deal offensive damage or copy a condition.

source.originalText: Blessing Echo: Transform a captured offensive Echo into a beneficial effect that can heal or protect allies.

card.name: Light Binding
card.effect: Choose mode: enemies make STR save or Restrained; they repeat save at turn end. OR up to 2 allies gain S d6+M temporary HP. No mixed modes; bonds are magical and not permanent objects.

source.originalText: Light Binding: Create bonds of radiant energy that can restrain enemies or create protective barriers for allies.

card.name: Corrupted Mirrorcall
card.effect: Roll d2:1 Ember grants its one commanded attack+1d4 fire; 2 Barbs grants+1d4 piercing. Extra dice apply once/round only. Mutation grants no aura damage, poison supply, resource gain or separate creature.

source.originalText: Corrupted Mirrorcall: Mirror Beast gains a random mutation (e.g., Burn Aura, Bleed Burst).

card.name: Shattered Mirror Beast
card.effect: Summon standard corrupted Beast. On commanded hit add 1d6 necrotic once/round; after that hit, each other creature within 5 ft of Beast, including allies, takes 1 psychic damage. This splash has no procs and cannot trigger another splash. Normal companion cap applies.

source.originalText: Shattered Mirror Beast: Summon a corrupted Mirror Beast with unstable, mutated abilities that can harm both enemies and allies.

card.name: Echo Leech
card.rangeAndTarget: Self after direct Echo damages a hostile creature
card.effect: Pay 1 RP to regain HP equal to min(M, actual damage dealt to one target). Copies, Do Ts and companion attacks do not trigger it. Healing has no secondary healing/resource procs; no damage means no heal.

source.originalText: Echo Leech: Drain life force from a target when casting certain Echo abilities, healing yourself.

classRecords.text: Weapon Synergy tracks last successful direct weapon hit on your own turns. Changing melee→ranged grants+1 to that ranged attack roll if it is your first attack of the turn; changing ranged→melee makes the hit apply Bleed 1d4 on target's next 2 turns. Once/turn synergy; Do Ts, copies, companions, forced attacks and misses do not advance it. At 5 ordinary Attack Action makes two attacks; techniques use only printed counts. You may draw/stow one weapon as normal object interaction; Dual Style later improves this.

Druidic Arrow Combo starts at Ranger 11, not at Base 1. Each direct successful weapon hit adds 1 Hit Chain, maximum 2 gained per regular turn and cap 3. Completing 3 primes one Arrow until end next turn; using it consumes the chain, even on miss. Efficient Killer lowers threshold 2. Chain starts/ends encounters 0, cannot be stocked against allies/captives/summons and is cleared by incapacitation. The Arrow is one Action with a ranged weapon attack or the stated save, costs 0 RP when primed, and is a magical class technique rather than an ordinary spell cast. At most one Arrow per round; it cannot advance its own chain. It requires a wielded bow and ammunition. Ordinary attack/damage riders apply once as printed, never another free arrow.

Chosen Hero grants a sixth Arrow at 11. Warder Nature's Wrath: ranged attack weapon+S d6 piercing; up to 2 allies within 10 ft gain M temporary HP (finite mitigation, not repeatable real healing). Stalker Phantom: two ranged attacks against different aligned targets within 60 ft, each weapon damage, no extra dice; one Arrow activation. Outrider Corruption: place 10 ft-radius zone within 60 ft, concentration until start next turn; up to 3 enemies entering/starting there take S d4 necrotic once each, CON half. Arrow copies cannot generate extra attacks, resources or permanent terrain changes.

Base choices 1–2, Pathfinder Arch 3–9, and chosen Warder/Stalker/Outrider Hero 10–20 are distinct stages. No source Arch capstone/Finale exists: level 9 receives its normal eligible choice, while 20 automatically improves your Hero Arrow once/long rest (new capstone below). Do not acquire a Hero by spending Base choices. Beast Companion is one permanent bond; it must be a willing/tamed noncorrupted beast with INT<7 and CR no greater than your class level. Its combat profile uses the bounded companion below rather than importing a full CR 20 monster.

card.name: Weapon Bond
card.rangeAndTarget: One bow or pair of blades touched
card.effect: Bond weapons. Bonus Action summons one bonded weapon to your hand from within 30 ft if not held by another creature and no total cover. Cannot disarm someone or cross planar boundaries; bond no additional items.

source.originalText: Weapon Bond: Form a special connection with either a bow or a pair of blades, allowing you to summon them to your hand.

card.name: Beast Empathy
card.rangeAndTarget: Natural beasts within 30 ft that hear you
card.effect: Communicate simple emotions/directions. They are not automatically friendly or controlled, cannot answer beyond their experience, and may need normal Animal Handling. No language-based compulsion or extra companion slot.

source.originalText: Beast Empathy: Communicate basic concepts with natural beasts.

card.name: Healing Touch
card.rangeAndTarget: One other ally healed by your paid spell/item
card.effect: Add M HP to actual healing. Do not multiply potion dice or duplicate consumed items; cannot apply to regeneration, companions' healing, copies or another Ranger's same bonus.

source.originalText: Healing Touch: Your healing spells and items are 25% more effective on allies.

card.name: Nature's Blessing
card.effect: Ally gains+10 ft Speed and S d6+M temporary HP on start. While effect lasts it has advantage on saves against forced movement. Temporary HP are not refreshed each turn.

source.originalText: Nature's Blessing: Grant an ally temporary bonuses to speed and resilience.

card.name: Beast Companion
card.cost: 4 RP; 1 hour with a willing/tamed eligible beast
card.effect: Bond eligible beast using standard companion stats plus Wisdom modifier HP; preserve one movement mode up to 40 ft and keen-sense advantage. Bonus Action command gives one attack, no imported boss powers. Injury persists; heal normally. Death requires a new bond after long rest, not free resummoning.

source.originalText: Beast Companion: Tame one beast from the bestiary (CR ≤ your level, INT < 7, not corrupted) as a permanent companion that scales with your Wisdom and level.

card.name: Predator's Grin
card.rangeAndTarget: Self after directly reducing quarry to 0
card.effect: Gain one extra full Action next turn within the shared cap. It cannot grant another Action or trigger another Predator's Grin. Allies, summons, helpless creatures and ongoing copied damage do not qualify.

source.originalText: Predator's Grin: Killing a tracked target grants you an extra action once per rest.

card.name: Master of the Hunt — new Hero capstone
card.effect: New playtest Hero capstone. Once per long rest when using your Hero Arrow, pay its normal Hit Chain/action requirements, then enhance only that activation: Warder grants 2 M temporary HP instead of M; Stalker adds S d6 piercing to one of its two hits; Outrider adds S d4 necrotic to one target on its single pulse. No extra Arrow, Hit Chain, action or copied proc.

classRecords.text: ABJURATION, provisional completion for the omitted eighth row: once per round after you cast an Abjuration spell, gain temporary HP equal to PB until the start of your next regular turn. CONJURATION: creatures summoned by your Wizard spells gain +1 maximum HP per Wizard level. DIVINATION: once per long rest reroll one failed saving throw and use the new result. ENCHANTMENT: when a creature fails its initial save against one of your Enchantment spells, a printed control duration of at least 1 round may last one additional round, but every normally allowed repeat save still occurs. EVOCATION: when casting an area Evocation spell, exclude one creature from its initial damaging area; that creature automatically succeeds and takes no damage if success normally halves damage. ILLUSION: gain +2 on concentration saves made to maintain Illusion spells. NECROMANCY: once per turn during a real encounter when a hostile non-summoned creature dies from your Necromancy spell, gain 1 temporary HP; it is not permanent healing. TRANSMUTATION: after casting a Transmutation spell, gain +5 feet Speed until the end of that turn.

SUMMON COMMAND LIMIT. All Wizard-controlled conjured, raised and bound companions share one damaging/control Companion Command per Wizard regular turn. Spend one Bonus Action to command exactly one such creature to move up to its Speed and use one damaging or control action from its stat block. Uncommanded creatures may reposition defensively and take Dodge but cannot deal damage or impose conditions. No summoned or raised creature can create XP, treasure, RP, Dissonance relief, additional corpses or kill-resource farms.

ELITE UNDEAD PETS. Necromancers may bind Boneflayer, Dreadblade and Wraithbound, at most one of each and three elite pets total. They use the same shared Companion Command limit as standard undead. Boneflayer: AC 14, HP 12 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30. Bone Shards: range 60, Wizard spell attack, 2d6+S necrotic. Fear Pulse replaces its attack: enemies within 10 feet make Wisdom saves; failure Frightened until end of next turn; recharge 3. Grave Miasma replaces its attack: 10-foot-radius point within 30 feet until start of your next turn; enemies entering or starting there take 1d6 necrotic once; recharge 3.

Flesh Ascendant's bonus applies after the listed base statistics: every undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard level. If at least two of your undead creatures are active, each gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. This does not increase the standard-minion or elite-pet caps.

card.name: Arcane Sight
card.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

card.name: Knowledge Shield
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per ally per round
card.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

card.name: Matrix Sharing
card.cost: 2 RP plus the shared spell's normal RP cost
card.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
card.effect: Matrix Sharing. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, matrix. Choose one prepared Wizard spell of rank 3 or lower with an Action casting time. Pay both costs now. The ally may cast that spell once before the end of its next turn without paying RP, using your spell attack and DC. The shared spell cannot summon creatures, create additional Actions, use Overcast, be Shared again or bypass concentration limits. Granting this permission takes your Action; the ally spends its own normal Action to cast. The ally owns concentration and strain for the cast, and it does not update your matrix-family history or grant you cast-trigger resources.

source.originalText: Matrix Sharing: Grant an ally temporary access to one of your prepared spells.

card.name: Spell Absorption
card.rangeAndTarget: One hostile spell that directly targets you
card.effect: Spell Absorption. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, abjuration. Trigger after you become the target of a hostile spell but before it resolves. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell rank. On success that spell has no effect on you, though it resolves normally against other targets, and you gain temporary HP equal to spell rank + M. On failure it resolves normally and the use is spent.

source.originalText: Spell Absorption: Absorb a hostile spell, gaining temporary hit points equal to the spell's level.

card.name: Arcane Fusion
card.cost: Combined normal RP costs of both spells + 2 RP
card.duration: Instantaneous or as individual legal effects
card.effect: Arcane Fusion. Tags: hero, elementalist, fusion, matrix. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 5 or lower, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Pay both full RP costs plus 2 and resolve both spells sequentially as one Action. They may share or have different legal targets. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates protected first-cast/Refrain state, but features triggered by 'casting a spell' may trigger only once from the Fusion, chosen by you. Fusion itself cannot be copied, Shared or used inside Dual Cast.

source.originalText: Arcane Fusion: Combine two spells into a single, more powerful effect.

card.name: Flesh Ascendant
card.effect: Flesh Ascendant. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, undead. Each undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard class level. While at least two of your undead creatures are active, each also gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. These bonuses apply after the common standard-minion and elite-pet statistics and do not increase companion caps or command frequency.

source.originalText: Flesh Ascendant: All undead gain +2 HP per Wizard level, if 2+ undead are active, gain +1 AC and Save

card.name: Arcane Leech
card.effect: Arcane Leech. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive. When at least one hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of your Wizard spells, gain temporary HP equal to S+M. Multiple failed targets from the same spell do not multiply the amount. This does not drain actual HP, generate RP or trigger from your companions' abilities.

source.originalText: Arcane Leech: Gain temporary hit points when a creature fails a save against your spells.

card.name: Binding Sigil
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature directly affected by your Wizard spell
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most one marked creature at a time
card.effect: Binding Sigil. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, mark. After one creature takes damage from or fails a save against your Wizard spell, you may mark it. Until the end of your next regular turn you have advantage on Wizard spell attacks against that creature. Marking another creature ends the previous mark. Echoes, companions and environmental damage cannot apply it.

source.originalText: Binding Sigil: Mark a creature, giving you advantage on spell attacks against it.

card.name: Corpse Harvest
card.rangeAndTarget: One eligible humanoid corpse within 30 feet
card.duration: Until destroyed, dismissed or your next long rest
card.effect: Corpse Harvest. Tags: hero, necromancer, wizard-spell, undead, summon. Raise the corpse as a Skeleton or Zombie using the common standard-undead statistics; a goblinoid corpse may instead become a Goblin Thrall. The corpse is consumed into that minion state. The creature obeys the shared Bonus Action Companion Command rule. Creating a fourth standard minion requires dismissing one existing standard minion first.

source.originalText: Corpse Harvest: Raise skeletons/goblins/zombies from slain humanoids

card.name: Ghoul Lash
card.rangeAndTarget: One of your standard undead minions with another allied undead within 5 feet
card.effect: Ghoul Lash. Tags: hero, necromancer, undead, command. Use your shared Companion Command on the chosen standard minion. If another undead you control is within 5 feet of it when commanded, it makes TWO copies of its normal damaging attack instead of one. Both attacks are part of the same single shared damaging command and cannot create additional commands, Actions or auto-raise events beyond the common once-per-round Auto-Raise limit.

source.originalText: Ghoul Lash: Minions within 1 tile of each other gain bonus attacks

card.name: Dual Cast
card.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
card.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

card.name: Arcane Feedback
card.effect: Source progression line 5191, converted from historical slot wording to RP. After your Counterspell successfully negates a spell, restore 1 RP, never above your normal maximum. A counter produced by a companion, reflected spell or copied Counterspell does not trigger this feature.

source.originalText: | 15 | Arcane Feedback (after successfully countering a spell, recover 1 RP once per round) |

classRecords.text: Wisdom governs spells, form attacks and class DC/M. Hit Die d8; book armor, weapons, saves and skills remain. Retain your own ability scores, HP, saves, proficiency and personality in all forms; form traits replace only the stated anatomy, movement and attacks. No additional monster stat block or separate beast HP pool. One natural attack per Attack Action unless a form explicitly states otherwise, attack PB+WIS, printed dice+WIS damage. Missing natural attack is 1d6 bludgeoning; default walking Speed 30 ft, normal AC, Medium size. Hawk is Tiny, Bear/Earth Warden/hero forms may be Large when space permits. Equipment melds and cannot be used while melded; magical numeric bonuses persist only if compatible with form anatomy and never duplicate armor.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: This class follows its explicit book progression instead of the ordinary 25-choice template. Base 1 grants Druidic, spellcasting, all five Base forms and 2 shifts/long rest. Choose one of seven Circles at 2; its level 2 features are a Base-stage exception. Enter the chosen Circle Arch path at 3, gain its 6 feature, then Circle Hero forms at 10 and its 14 feature. Arch Forms unlock 11 despite the historical word Arch; these are forms, not a second promotion. At 11 attune up to 2 Arch forms during long rest. Base forms remain available at higher levels. All features below are automatic at their gate for the chosen Circle; no generic extra class-card choices are added.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: ELEMENTAL FAMILIAR. Conjure Elemental Familiar creates one familiar matching your current Focus; you may have only one elemental familiar. AC = 12 + PB; HP = 5 + Mage level + M; Speed 30 feet; Lightning familiar additionally has Fly 30 feet, Fire has resistance to fire, Cold has resistance to cold. It uses your saves and PB where required. Elemental Dart: ranged spell attack using your Mage spell attack, range 30 feet, hit S d4 damage of its element. It cannot generate RP, Dissonance, Focus casts, corpses, XP, loot or kill-trigger resources.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: BONEFLAYER. Medium undead; AC 14; HP = 12 + 2 × Mage level; Speed 30 feet. Bone Shards: range 60 feet, your Mage spell attack, hit 2d6 + S necrotic. Fear Pulse: instead of Bone Shards, enemies of your choice within 10 feet make Wisdom saves against your Mage DC; failure causes Frightened until the end of their next turn; recharge 3 rounds. Grave Miasma: instead of Bone Shards, one 10-foot-radius point within 30 feet persists until the start of your next turn; enemies entering or starting there take 1d6 necrotic once; recharge 3 rounds.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: DREADBLADE. Medium undead; AC 16; HP = 16 + 3 × Mage level; Speed 30 feet. Disrupting Blade: melee spell attack using your Mage attack bonus, reach 5 feet, hit 1d8 + S necrotic. If the target is concentrating it immediately makes its concentration save with disadvantage. On a natural 20, the target is Weakened until the end of its next turn, taking -1 to attack rolls. Dreadblade has advantage on saves against forced movement.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: WRAITHBOUND. Medium undead; AC 14; HP = 10 + 2 × Mage level; Fly 40 feet and can hover. While it has not attacked or imposed control since the end of its previous turn, it is Invisible; attacking ends that state until the end of its next turn. Wraith Strike: melee spell attack using your Mage attack bonus, reach 5 feet, hit 1d8 + S necrotic. On a natural 20, the target makes a Constitution save against your Mage DC; failure Stuns it until the end of its next turn.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: Before the irreversible Lich roll, the Director must explicitly tell the player the historical failure stakes: permanent loss of spellcasting, transformation into a cursed melee undead NPC, hostile faction consequences, cursed-gear restriction and no further XP as that retired PC. The player must explicitly opt into that retirement risk before rolling. If the player declines, the ritual stops before the roll and the character must choose another Hero path for this playtest; no irreversible consequence is applied.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

card.name: Undying Spellform
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.effect: Undying Spellform. Tags: lich, undead, death. When damage reduces you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain conscious and able to take Actions until the end of your next regular turn. You remain at 0 HP, cannot benefit from voluntary movement faster than half Speed, and still suffer ordinary consequences of further damage. If still at 0 HP when the effect ends, become unconscious and suffer one failed death save. Healing above 0 ends this feature early.

source.originalText: Undying Spellform: When reduced to 0 HP, continue casting for 1 full round before death.

classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

card.name: Undead Immunities
card.effect: Undead Immunities. Tags: lich, undead. You are immune to poison damage, the Poisoned condition, disease, Frightened, Charmed and magical sleep. You no longer need to breathe. You still require the normal rest schedule for mechanical recovery and can still be affected by abilities that specifically target undead unless another feature says otherwise.

source.originalText: Undead Immunities: Become immune to poison, disease, fear, sleep, and mind control.

classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: Echo Release costs the Core V 2 RP cost of the recorded rank, minimum 2, consumes its record and counts as a spell for Dissonance and Refrain. Spell attack/DC use your own stats. First release of a newly captured record ignores Refrain addition only; base strain remains. Any preserved subsequent release uses ordinary repeated-spell strain. All released Echoes, pet replays, fusions and reflections share ONE release action per round; a specifically combined package counts once but pays for every component and has its printed damage cap. Copies cannot create resources or recursive Echoes.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

card.name: Shatterbind
card.effect: You may change its damage type to necrotic or psychic on release. Category/eligibility/rank stay unchanged; high-INT undead and bosses remain excluded unless an encounter explicitly permits them.

source.originalText: Shatterbind: Echoes from undead/demons/aberrations gain necrotic or psychic damage tags.

classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: NECROMANCER STANDARD UNDEAD. Corpse Harvest and Auto-Raise share a maximum of three standard raised minions. Skeleton: AC 14, HP 6 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30; Bone Shot, range 30 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d6+S necrotic. Zombie: AC 12, HP 10 + 3 × Wizard level, Speed 20; Slam, reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic. Goblin Thrall, available only from a goblinoid corpse: AC 13, HP 8 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30; Shiv, reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d6+S necrotic. These are pre-Flesh-Ascendant statistics.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: NECROMANCER AUTO-RAISE. Once per round when one of your standard undead minions personally lands the killing blow on an eligible humanoid and your standard-minion count is below three, its corpse rises at the end of the current turn as the same mechanical minion type that scored the kill, if physically possible. A new minion cannot act during that same round. Auto-Raise costs no Action or RP but can never exceed the three-minion cap or generate a new resource, corpse chain, XP or treasure event. Without Infernal Pact only humanoids qualify.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: Dreadblade: AC 16, HP 16 + 3 × Wizard level, Speed 30. Disrupting Blade: reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic; a concentrating target immediately makes its concentration save with disadvantage. On a natural 20 the target is Weakened until the end of its next turn, taking -1 on attack rolls. Dreadblade has advantage on saves against forced movement.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: Wraithbound: AC 14, HP 10 + 2 × Wizard level, Fly 40 and hover. While it has not attacked or imposed control since the end of its previous turn it is Invisible; attacking ends that state until the end of its next turn. Wraith Strike: reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic. On natural 20 the target makes a Constitution save against your Wizard DC; failure Stuns until the end of its next turn.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

classRecords.text: DARK-TRAUMA INTERFACE. Necromancer features involving corpse desecration, infernal bargains, domination, body control or Mind Prison remain subject to the project's existing dark-content and trauma boundaries. A table may fade description to black without changing mechanics. No feature changes a player's real belief, permanently transfers ownership of a player character or silently retires a PC.
classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

card.name: Infernal Pact (Quest-based unlock)
card.effect: Infernal Pact — Gravebrand. Tags: hero, necromancer, infernal, necrotic, dark-content. This card can be selected only after completing the campaign's Infernal Pact quest and its dark-trauma check-in. Mark one creature. At the start of each of its turns it makes a Constitution save; on failure it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you regain HP equal to the actual damage dealt, maximum S+M; success ends Gravebrand. Gravebrand ignores necrotic resistance but not immunity. While you possess this Pact, Corpse Harvest and Auto-Raise may also treat Fiend corpses as eligible; other creature types remain ineligible.

source.originalText: Infernal Pact (Quest-based unlock): Grants Gravebrand: 1d6 necrotic per round, heals caster, overrides corpse resistance

classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic companion supplement to original broad lifecycle inventory

supportingSources.paragraphPrefix: Where a class card calls for a
supportingSources.text: Where a class card calls for a **standard companion** without a more specific profile, use: Small or Medium; AC 12+floor(PB/2); HP 2 L; walking Speed 30 ft; saves equal owner's PB; one melee or ranged attack (reach 5 ft/range 30 ft) at owner's class attack bonus, damage S d6 of the printed type. It has no independent class features, resources, loot, death triggers or extra turns. All companions belonging to one character share one Bonus Action command and **one damaging attack/action total per round** unless a specifically priced feature grants more. Without a command they move and Dodge. Act immediately after owner. A standard companion lasts 1 minute, disappears at 0 HP and cannot be healed for free by dismissing/resummoning. The creation cost must be paid again. Creature-specific stat blocks override this profile only where explicitly printed.

One regular Action, one Bonus Action if a feature permits it, normal movement and one Reaction between starts of your turns. A free trigger costs no Action only if expressly stated. All grants share **one extra full Action per creature per round**. An extra Action cannot grant another Action, recharge itself, or start another extra-Action grant. It supplies no extra Bonus Action or Reaction. A card granting additional attacks is not permission to repeat all class riders on every hit: obey each rider's frequency.

No damage/healing copy repeats the source's costs, procs, resource generation, critical bonus dice, buffs, actions, cooldown resets or duration. Compute fractions once, capped at 100% of one stored source unless an explicit card states a separately priced higher amount. Copies still cause ordinary damage consequences, concentration checks and death. A copy cannot copy another copy. A target/source record must refer to an actual resolved event, not merely a known ability name.
